Comic Pages now adds a **Comic Pages** entry to Silo's user sidebar. It opens a
short page explaining how to read CBR comics in Aidoku.

The entry also lists the plugin in Silo's user plugin settings. The Aidoku Silo
source v11 and newer uses that listing to find the installation automatically,
so readers no longer paste an installation ID. Sources v5 to v10 keep working
with a manually entered ID.

Page extraction, the cache, and resource limits are unchanged.

[Installation](https://github.com/crowquillx/silo-comic-pages#install)

Linux amd64 and arm64 binaries, SHA-256 checksums, and dependency license
notices are attached. No live server installation is part of this release.
